classes.name: Barbarian
classes.description: A furious warrior who channels rage into raw damage and refuses to go down while the fight is still on.

subclassDescriptions.Path of the Berserker: Pure, reckless fury. While raging you can enter a frenzy and make an extra weapon attack every turn, at the cost of exhaustion afterwards. Later you can't be charmed or frightened while raging and you can terrify enemies with a look. Best for players who want to hit as hard and as often as possible.
subclassDescriptions.Path of the Totem Warrior: A spiritual barbarian bonded to an animal spirit. You choose a totem (bear, eagle, wolf...) at several levels: Bear makes you resist almost all damage while raging, Eagle makes you fast and mobile, Wolf helps allies hit the enemies next to you. Flexible and very tough; great if you want to protect the party.
subclassDescriptions.Path of the Zealot: A warrior blessed (or cursed) by a god of battle. Your rage adds extra radiant or necrotic damage, you can be raised from the dead for free, and at high level you simply refuse to die while raging. Ideal for a fearless front-liner who wants to stay in the fight no matter what.

features.name: Rage
features.description: Enter a fury as a bonus action: advantage on Strength checks and saves, bonus melee damage and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: Without armor, your AC equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Constitution modifiers; a shield still applies.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.description: You have advantage on Dexterity saves against effects you can see, such as traps and spells, while not blinded, deafened or incapacitated.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: Gain advantage on Strength melee attacks this turn, but attacks against you have advantage until your next turn.

features.name: Divine Fury
features.description: The first creature you hit each turn while raging takes extra necrotic or radiant damage.

features.name: Frenzy
features.description: While raging you may make one melee attack as a bonus action each turn, at the cost of a level of exhaustion when the rage ends.

features.name: Primal Path
features.description: Choose the path that shapes the source and style of your rage.

features.name: Spirit Seeker
features.description: You can cast beast sense and speak with animals as rituals.

features.name: Totem Spirit
features.description: Bond with a bear, eagle or wolf spirit to gain a defensive or tactical benefit while raging.

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
features.description: Spells that bring you back from death need no material components.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.description: Your speed rises by 10 feet while you are not wearing heavy armor.

features.name: Aspect of the Beast
features.description: Your chosen totem animal grants a lasting physical gift such as carrying capacity, keen sight or tracking skill.

features.name: Fanatical Focus
features.description: Once per rage you can reroll a failed saving throw and must use the new roll.

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.description: You cannot be charmed or frightened while raging, and such effects are paused during your rage.

features.name: Feral Instinct
features.description: You gain advantage on initiative and can act normally on a surprised turn if you rage first.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Brutal Critical (1 die)
features.description: Roll one additional weapon damage die when you score a critical hit with a melee attack.

features.name: Intimidating Presence
features.description: Use your action to frighten a creature you can see within 30 feet unless it passes a Wisdom save.

features.name: Spirit Walker
features.description: You can cast commune with nature as a ritual to receive guidance from a totem spirit.

features.name: Zealous Presence
features.description: As a bonus action, up to ten allies gain advantage on attacks and saves until your next turn, once per long rest.

features.name: Relentless Rage
features.description: When raging and dropped to 0 hit points, a Constitution save (DC rising with each use) leaves you at 1 hit point instead.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Brutal Critical (2 dice)
features.description: Your melee critical hits now add two extra weapon damage dice.

features.name: Rage Beyond Death
features.description: While raging, dropping to 0 hit points does not knock you out or kill you until the rage ends.

features.name: Retaliation
features.description: When a creature within 5 feet damages you, you can use your reaction to strike back with a melee attack.

features.name: Totemic Attunement
features.description: Your totem grants a powerful new aura or ability while you rage.

features.name: Persistent Rage
features.description: Your rage only ends early if you fall unconscious or choose to stop it.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Brutal Critical (3 dice)
features.description: Your melee critical hits now add three extra weapon damage dice.

features.name: Indomitable Might
features.description: If a Strength check totals less than your Strength score, use the score as the result.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Primal Champion
features.description: Your Strength and Constitution scores each grow by 4, up to a new maximum of 24.

classes.name: Bard
classes.description: An inspiring performer whose magic comes from words and music, and who somehow knows a little of everything.

subclassDescriptions.College of Glamour: Bards touched by the Feywild who enchant crowds. Your performances give allies temporary hit points and free movement, and you can charm or frighten groups and wrap yourself in an awe-inspiring aura. Good for a charismatic support who controls the battlefield and social scenes.
subclassDescriptions.College of Lore: Collectors of knowledge and secrets. You gain extra skill proficiencies, can use Bardic Inspiration to make enemies miss or fail checks (Cutting Words), and learn spells from other classes' lists early. The most flexible bard: a skill expert and the best spell 'thief' in the game.
subclassDescriptions.College of Valor: Battle-skalds who sing in the front line. You gain medium armour, shields and martial weapons, your inspiration can boost an ally's damage or armour class, and later you attack twice and can cast a spell and swing in the same turn. Choose this if you want a bard who fights.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration (d6)
features.description: As a bonus action, give an ally a d6 to add to one attack roll, ability check or save within the next 10 minutes.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Cast bard spells using Charisma, drawing on music and words as your arcane focus.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.description: Add half your proficiency bonus to any ability check that does not already use it.

features.name: Song of Rest (d6)
features.description: Allies who spend Hit Dice during a short rest while hearing you regain an extra d6 hit points.

features.name: Bard College
features.description: Join a college of bards that shapes your talents and training.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency in three skills of your choice.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency with medium armor, shields and martial weapons.

features.name: Combat Inspiration
features.description: Allies can spend your inspiration die on weapon damage or to raise their AC against one attack.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.description: Spend a Bardic Inspiration die as a reaction to subtract it from a creature's attack roll, ability check or damage roll.

features.name: Enthralling Performance
features.description: After performing for at least a minute, charm a few listeners who fail a Wisdom save for an hour.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Double your proficiency bonus for two skills you are proficient in.

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
features.description: Spend a Bardic Inspiration use to grant nearby allies temporary hit points and a free reaction move.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration (d8)
features.description: Your inspiration die becomes a d8.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.description: You regain all uses of Bardic Inspiration on a short or long rest.

features.name: Additional Magical Secrets
features.description: Learn two spells from any class's spell list early.

features.name: Countercharm
features.description: Perform as an action so nearby allies have advantage on saves against being charmed or frightened.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Mantle of Majesty
features.description: Take on an awe-inspiring fey appearance and cast command as a bonus action each turn for a minute.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Song of Rest (d8)
features.description: Your Song of Rest bonus healing becomes a d8.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration (d10)
features.description: Your inspiration die becomes a d10.

features.name: Expertise (additional)
features.description: Choose two more proficient skills to gain double proficiency.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.description: Learn two spells from any class's list; they count as bard spells for you.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Song of Rest (d10)
features.description: Your Song of Rest bonus healing becomes a d10.

features.name: Battle Magic
features.description: After casting a bard spell with your action, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

features.name: Magical Secrets (additional)
features.description: Learn two more spells from any class's spell list.

features.name: Peerless Skill
features.description: Spend a Bardic Inspiration die to boost one of your own ability checks.

features.name: Unbreakable Majesty
features.description: Assume a majestic presence that forces attackers to save or pick a new target.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration (d12)
features.description: Your inspiration die becomes a d12.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Song of Rest (d12)
features.description: Your Song of Rest bonus healing becomes a d12.

features.name: Magical Secrets (final)
features.description: Learn another two spells from any class's spell list.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Superior Inspiration
features.description: If you roll initiative with no Bardic Inspiration uses left, you regain one.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: A divine caster who channels a deity's power to heal allies, turn undead, and smite the unworthy.

subclassDescriptions.Life Domain: The classic healer. Every healing spell you cast heals extra hit points, you can heal several allies at once with Channel Divinity, and you wear heavy armour. Later your healing also heals you. Best for players who want to keep the party alive.
subclassDescriptions.Light Domain: Priests of the sun and fire. You get blasting spells like Burning Hands and Fireball, can flash light to make an attacker miss, and Channel Divinity floods the area with radiant light that burns enemies. A damage-focused cleric that still heals.
subclassDescriptions.Tempest Domain: Servants of storm gods. You wear heavy armour, punish attackers with lightning, and can make your thunder and lightning spells deal maximum damage. Thunderwave and Call Lightning are your signature spells. Great for a tough, explosive front-line caster.
subclassDescriptions.War Domain: Clerics of war gods who fight in heavy armour with martial weapons. You can make extra attacks as a bonus action, add a big bonus to a single attack roll, and later resist weapon damage. Pick this for a holy warrior who prays and punches.

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.description: Learn the light cantrip if you do not already know it.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: Gain proficiency with heavy armor.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.description: Healing spells of 1st level or higher restore extra hit points equal to 2 plus the spell's level.

features.name: Divine Domain
features.description: Choose a domain of your deity, granting domain spells and extra features.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Prepare and cast cleric spells using Wisdom, channeling your deity's power through a holy symbol.

features.name: War Priest
features.description: After taking the Attack action, make one extra weapon attack as a bonus action a few times per long rest.

features.name: Warding Flare
features.description: As a reaction, impose disadvantage on an attack against you by flashing divine light at the attacker.

features.name: Wrath of the Storm
features.description: As a reaction, deal lightning or thunder damage to a nearby creature that hits you.

features.name: Channel Divinity (1/rest)
features.description: Channel divine energy once per short or long rest to fuel special effects.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath
features.description: Maximize the damage of a lightning or thunder roll instead of rolling it.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
features.description: Add +10 to one of your attack rolls after seeing the roll.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
features.description: Distribute a pool of healing equal to five times your cleric level among nearby wounded creatures.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
features.description: Dispel magical darkness and blast nearby hostile creatures with radiant damage.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn Undead
features.description: Present your holy symbol to make nearby undead flee unless they pass a Wisdom save.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 1/2)
features.description: Undead of challenge rating 1/2 or lower that fail against your Turn Undead are destroyed outright.

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.description: When you heal someone else with a spell, you also regain hit points.

features.name: Channel Divinity (2/rest)
features.description: You can channel divinity twice between rests.

features.name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing
features.description: Use your reaction to give an ally within 30 feet +10 on an attack roll.

features.name: Improved Flare
features.description: You can use Warding Flare to protect allies as well as yourself.

features.name: Thunderbolt Strike
features.description: Your lightning damage can push Large or smaller creatures 10 feet away.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 1)
features.description: Turn Undead now destroys undead of challenge rating 1 or lower.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once per turn, your weapon hits deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage, rising to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once per turn, your weapon hits deal an extra 1d8 thunder damage, rising to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once per turn, your weapon hits deal an extra 1d8 damage of the weapon's type, rising to 2d8 at 14th level.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of your cleric cantrips.

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.description: Call on your deity for aid; if a percentile roll is at or below your cleric level, the god intervenes.

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 2)
features.description: Turn Undead now destroys undead of challenge rating 2 or lower.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 3)
features.description: Turn Undead now destroys undead of challenge rating 3 or lower.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.description: You resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical weapons.

features.name: Corona of Light
features.description: Emit sunlight for a minute that gives enemies disadvantage on saves against fire and radiant spells.

features.name: Destroy Undead (CR 4)
features.description: Turn Undead now destroys undead of challenge rating 4 or lower.

features.name: Stormborn
features.description: You gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed whenever you are outdoors and not underground.

features.name: Supreme Healing
features.description: Your healing spells use the maximum value of their dice instead of rolling.

features.name: Channel Divinity (3/rest)
features.description: You can channel divinity three times between rests.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Divine Intervention Improvement
features.description: Your calls for divine intervention succeed automatically.

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: A guardian of the wild who shapes the elements and takes the form of beasts.

subclassDescriptions.Circle of Spores: Druids of decay and the cycle of rot. You wrap yourself in a halo of spores that damages nearby enemies, can animate fallen creatures as zombies, and gain a symbiotic form with extra hit points and poison damage on hits. A close-range, grim druid.
subclassDescriptions.Circle of the Land: Druids tied to one kind of land (forest, mountain, swamp...). Once a day you recover some spell slots on a short rest and get extra spells from your chosen land, always prepared. Later nature can't harm or slow you. The best pure spellcaster druid.
subclassDescriptions.Circle of the Moon: Shapeshifters. You Wild Shape as a bonus action into much stronger beasts (bears, later elementals) and can heal in beast form by spending spell slots. Pick this if you want to fight as an animal in melee.

features.name: Druidic
features.description: You know the secret druid language and can leave hidden messages in it.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Prepare and cast druid spells using Wisdom, drawing on the power of nature.

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.description: Learn one additional druid cantrip.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.description: Wild Shape into tougher beasts, up to CR 1 now and higher as you level.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: Gain the chill touch cantrip and decay-themed spells that are always prepared.

features.name: Combat Wild Shape
features.description: Wild Shape as a bonus action and burn spell slots to heal while transformed.

features.name: Druid Circle
features.description: Choose a circle of druids that defines your bond with nature.

features.name: Halo of Spores
features.description: As a reaction, deal necrotic damage to a creature that moves near you or starts its turn close by.

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.description: Once per day during a short rest, recover some expended spell slots.

features.name: Symbiotic Entity
features.description: Spend Wild Shape to gain temporary hit points and boost your spores and melee attacks with necrotic damage.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.description: Magically turn into a beast you have seen, twice per short rest, starting with CR 1/4 forms without flying or swimming.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: Your bond with a chosen terrain grants you extra always-prepared spells as you level.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Wild Shape Improvement (CR 1/2)
features.description: You can transform into beasts up to CR 1/2, including ones that swim.

features.name: Fungal Infestation
features.description: When a small creature dies near you, animate it as a temporary zombie servant.

features.name: Land's Stride
features.description: Nonmagical difficult terrain and plants do not slow or harm you, and you resist magical plant effects.

features.name: Primal Strike
features.description: Your attacks in beast form count as magical for overcoming resistance.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Wild Shape Improvement (CR 1)
features.description: You can transform into beasts up to CR 1, including ones that fly.

features.name: Elemental Wild Shape
features.description: Spend two uses of Wild Shape to become an air, earth, fire or water elemental.

features.name: Nature's Ward
features.description: You cannot be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey and are immune to poison and disease.

features.name: Spreading Spores
features.description: Hurl your spores into a cube that damages creatures moving through it.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Fungal Body
features.description: You cannot be blinded, deafened, frightened or poisoned, and critical hits against you become normal hits.

features.name: Nature's Sanctuary
features.description: Beasts and plants must pass a Wisdom save before they can attack you.

features.name: Thousand Forms
features.description: You can cast alter self at will.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Beast Spells
features.description: You can cast many druid spells while in a beast form.

features.name: Timeless Body
features.description: Primal magic makes you age only one year for every ten that pass.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Archdruid
features.description: You can use Wild Shape without limit and ignore many spell components.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: A master of every weapon and armor there is, defined by sheer martial versatility and staying power.

subclassDescriptions.Battle Master: A tactician. You learn manoeuvres powered by superiority dice: trip enemies, disarm them, push them back, command allies to attack, or riposte. Every hit can be a tactical choice. Best for players who like options and control in combat.
subclassDescriptions.Champion: Simple and deadly. Your critical hits happen on a 19 or 20 (later 18-20), you become more athletic, gain a second fighting style and regenerate hit points when badly hurt. Very easy to play: you just hit hard and crit often.
subclassDescriptions.Eldritch Knight: A fighter who learns wizard spells (mostly abjuration and evocation, like Shield and Magic Missile). You can bond to your weapon so it can't be taken from you, and later attack and cast in the same turn. Great for a sturdy warrior with a bit of magic.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Adopt a combat specialty such as Archery, Defense, Dueling or Great Weapon Fighting.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: As a bonus action, regain 1d10 plus your fighter level in hit points once per short rest.

features.name: Action Surge (one use)
features.description: Take one additional action on your turn once per short rest.

features.name: Combat Superiority
features.description: Learn maneuvers fueled by superiority dice (d8) that add tactical effects to your attacks.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

features.name: Martial Archetype
features.description: Choose the archetype that defines your fighting techniques.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Learn a small set of wizard spells, mostly abjuration and evocation, cast with Intelligence.

features.name: Student of War
features.description: Gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools.

features.name: Weapon Bond
features.description: Bond with up to two weapons so they cannot be disarmed and can be summoned to your hand.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Know Your Enemy
features.description: Study a creature for a minute to learn how it compares to you in key capabilities.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.description: Add half your proficiency bonus to untrained Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks and leap farther.

features.name: War Magic
features.description: After casting a cantrip with your action, make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Indomitable (one use)
features.description: Reroll a failed saving throw once per long rest.

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.description: Pick a second Fighting Style option.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.description: A creature you hit with a weapon has disadvantage on its next save against your spells.

features.name: Improved Combat Superiority (d10)
features.description: Your superiority dice become d10s.

features.name: Extra Attack (2)
features.description: You now attack three times with the Attack action.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Indomitable (two uses)
features.description: You can use Indomitable twice per long rest.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.description: When you Action Surge, you can also teleport up to 30 feet.

features.name: Relentless
features.description: If you roll initiative with no superiority dice left, you regain one.

features.name: Superior Critical
features.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18 to 20.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Action Surge (two uses)
features.description: You can use Action Surge twice between rests, but only once per turn.

features.name: Indomitable (three uses)
features.description: You can use Indomitable three times per long rest.

features.name: Improved Combat Superiority (d12)
features.description: Your superiority dice become d12s.

features.name: Improved War Magic
features.description: After casting any spell with your action, make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

features.name: Survivor
features.description: At the start of each turn, regain a few hit points if you are at or below half health but above 0.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Extra Attack (3)
features.description: You now attack four times with the Attack action.

classes.name: Monk
classes.description: A martial artist who turns body and ki into a weapon, striking many times in the space others take to swing once.

subclassDescriptions.Way of Shadow: Ninja-like monks. You spend ki to cast Darkness, Silence and similar spells, teleport from shadow to shadow, and later become invisible in dim light. A stealthy infiltrator and assassin.
subclassDescriptions.Way of the Four Elements: Monks who bend the elements. You spend ki to throw fire, water, earth and air effects (fire blasts, gusts, walls of water), effectively a monk that casts spells. Flashy but ki-hungry.
subclassDescriptions.Way of the Open Hand: Masters of unarmed combat. Your Flurry of Blows can knock enemies prone, push them away or stop their reactions; you can heal yourself and later kill with a single touch. The classic, most reliable monk.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.description: Use Dexterity for unarmed and monk weapon attacks, roll a martial arts die for damage and punch as a bonus action.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: Without armor or a shield, your AC equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Wisdom modifiers.

features.name: Ki
features.description: Spend ki points on Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense and Step of the Wind, regaining them on a rest.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.description: Your speed increases while you wear no armor or shield, growing as you level.

features.name: Deflect Missiles
features.description: Use your reaction to reduce damage from a ranged weapon attack and possibly throw the missile back.

features.name: Disciple of the Elements
features.description: Learn elemental disciplines that spend ki to produce elemental spell effects.

features.name: Monastic Tradition
features.description: Commit to a monastic tradition that shapes your ki techniques.

features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.description: Flurry of Blows hits can knock a target prone, push it away or deny it reactions.

features.name: Shadow Arts
features.description: Spend ki to cast darkness, darkvision, pass without trace or silence, and learn minor illusion.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Slow Fall
features.description: Use your reaction to greatly reduce falling damage.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Stunning Strike
features.description: Spend 1 ki after a melee hit to try to stun the target until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Elemental Discipline (second)
features.description: Learn an additional elemental discipline.

features.name: Ki-Empowered Strikes
features.description: Your unarmed strikes count as magical.

features.name: Shadow Step
features.description: Teleport between areas of dim light or darkness and gain advantage on your next melee attack.

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.description: Use your action to regain hit points equal to three times your monk level once per long rest.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: Take no damage on a successful Dexterity save for half damage, and only half on a failure.

features.name: Stillness of Mind
features.description: Use your action to end a charm or fear effect on yourself.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Unarmored Movement Improvement
features.description: You can move along vertical surfaces and across liquids during your turn.

features.name: Purity of Body
features.description: You are immune to disease and poison.

features.name: Cloak of Shadows
features.description: Become invisible while standing in dim light or darkness.

features.name: Elemental Discipline (third)
features.description: Learn another elemental discipline.

features.name: Tranquility
features.description: After a long rest you are protected by a sanctuary effect until you attack or it ends.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon
features.description: You understand all spoken languages and anyone who knows a language understands you.

features.name: Diamond Soul
features.description: Gain proficiency in all saving throws and spend ki to reroll a failed save.

features.name: Timeless Body
features.description: You no longer suffer the frailty of old age and need no food or water.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Elemental Discipline (fourth)
features.description: Learn a fourth elemental discipline.

features.name: Opportunist
features.description: Use your reaction to attack a nearby creature that was just hit by someone else.

features.name: Quivering Palm
features.description: Plant lethal vibrations with an unarmed strike that you can later trigger to drop or heavily damage the target.

features.name: Empty Body
features.description: Spend ki to turn invisible and resistant to most damage, or to cast astral projection.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Perfect Self
features.description: If you roll initiative with no ki remaining, you regain 4 ki points.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: A holy warrior bound by an oath, blending heavy armor with divine smites and an aura that steadies allies.

subclassDescriptions.Oath of Devotion: The knight in shining armour, sworn to honesty and justice. You can make your weapon holy (add Charisma to attack rolls), turn fiends and undead, and later you and nearby allies can't be charmed. A loyal protector.
subclassDescriptions.Oath of Vengeance: Avenger sworn to punish great evil. You can mark one enemy and gain advantage against it (Vow of Enmity), move after anyone who attacks you, and later fly and strike back. The most aggressive single-target paladin.
subclassDescriptions.Oath of the Ancients: Green knights who defend life, joy and nature. You can entangle enemies in vines, and your aura makes allies resist damage from spells. Later you can return from near death. A protector against magic.

features.name: Divine Sense
features.description: Sense the location of celestials, fiends and undead nearby a few times per long rest.

features.name: Lay on Hands
features.description: Heal from a pool of five hit points per paladin level, or spend 5 to cure a disease or poison.

features.name: Divine Smite
features.description: Expend a spell slot after a melee hit to deal extra radiant damage, more against undead and fiends.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Adopt a combat specialty such as Defense, Dueling or Protection.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Prepare and cast paladin spells using Charisma.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Abjure Enemy
features.description: Frighten a creature and stop it from moving unless it passes a Wisdom save.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Nature's Wrath
features.description: Spectral vines restrain a creature that fails a Strength or Dexterity save.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon
features.description: Imbue a weapon to add your Charisma modifier to its attack rolls and make it shed light.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Faithless
features.description: Force nearby fey and fiends to flee unless they pass a Wisdom save.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Unholy
features.description: Force nearby fiends and undead to flee unless they pass a Wisdom save.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Vow of Enmity
features.description: Gain advantage on attack rolls against one creature for a minute.

features.name: Divine Health
features.description: You are immune to disease.

features.name: Sacred Oath
features.description: Swear an oath that grants oath spells and Channel Divinity options.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.description: You and nearby allies add your Charisma modifier to saving throws while you are conscious.

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.description: You and nearby allies cannot be charmed while you are conscious.

features.name: Aura of Warding
features.description: You and nearby allies resist damage from spells.

features.name: Relentless Avenger
features.description: After hitting with an opportunity attack, move up to half your speed without provoking.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Aura of Courage
features.description: You and nearby allies cannot be frightened while you are conscious.

features.name: Improved Divine Smite
features.description: Every melee weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 radiant damage.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Cleansing Touch
features.description: End one spell on yourself or a willing creature you touch a few times per long rest.

features.name: Purity of Spirit
features.description: You are always under the effect of protection from evil and good.

features.name: Soul of Vengeance
features.description: When the target of your Vow of Enmity attacks, you can make a melee attack against it as a reaction.

features.name: Undying Sentinel
features.description: Once per long rest, drop to 1 hit point instead of 0, and stop showing the effects of age.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Aura Improvements
features.description: The range of your auras grows to 30 feet.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Avenging Angel
features.description: Sprout wings for flight and project a frightening aura for an hour.

features.name: Elder Champion
features.description: Transform into a force of nature that regenerates, casts quickly and hinders enemy saves.

features.name: Holy Nimbus
features.description: Radiate bright sunlight that damages nearby enemies and grants advantage on saves against fiend and undead spells.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: A hunter and tracker at home in the wilds, deadly at range and unmatched at finding what does not want to be found.

subclassDescriptions.Beast Master: A ranger with a loyal animal companion (wolf, panther, hawk...) that fights beside you on your command. The companion grows stronger as you level. Choose this if you want a pet that matters in combat.
subclassDescriptions.Gloom Stalker: Hunters of the dark places. You act first in combat with an extra attack on the first turn, are invisible to creatures relying on darkvision, and resist fear. Excellent ambusher and scout.
subclassDescriptions.Hunter: Specialist slayer. At several levels you choose a technique: extra damage to wounded foes, hitting several enemies at once, defending against packs or giant monsters. A simple, strong damage ranger.

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.description: Choose a creature type you have studied, gaining advantage on tracking and recalling lore about it.

features.name: Natural Explorer
features.description: Become an expert in a favored terrain, traveling and foraging there with ease.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Adopt a combat specialty such as Archery, Defense, Dueling or Two-Weapon Fighting.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Learn and cast ranger spells using Wisdom.

features.name: Dread Ambusher
features.description: Gain bonus initiative and a faster, harder-hitting first turn of combat.

features.name: Gloom Stalker Magic
features.description: Learn extra shadowy spells such as disguise self that are always known.

features.name: Hunter's Prey
features.description: Choose Colossus Slayer, Giant Killer or Horde Breaker to specialize in a type of quarry.

features.name: Primeval Awareness
features.description: Spend a spell slot to sense certain creature types in the surrounding miles.

features.name: Ranger Archetype
features.description: Choose the archetype that defines your approach to the wilds.

features.name: Ranger's Companion
features.description: Gain a loyal beast companion that fights alongside you at your command.

features.name: Umbral Sight
features.description: Gain or extend darkvision and become invisible to creatures relying on darkvision to see you.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Favored Enemy Improvement
features.description: Choose an additional favored enemy and language.

features.name: Natural Explorer Improvement
features.description: Choose an additional favored terrain.

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.description: Choose a defense against crowds, fear or multiattacking foes.

features.name: Exceptional Training
features.description: Your companion can Dash, Disengage, Dodge or Help as a bonus action, and its attacks count as magical.

features.name: Iron Mind
features.description: Gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws or another save if you already have it.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Land's Stride
features.description: Nonmagical difficult terrain does not slow you and you resist magical plant effects.

features.name: Hide in Plain Sight
features.description: Spend a minute camouflaging yourself to gain a large bonus to Stealth while you stay still.

features.name: Natural Explorer Improvement (third terrain)
features.description: Choose a third favored terrain.

features.name: Bestial Fury
features.description: Your companion can make two attacks when you command it to attack.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: Choose Volley or Whirlwind Attack to strike many enemies at once.

features.name: Stalker's Flurry
features.description: Once per turn when you miss with a weapon attack, you can make another attack.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Favored Enemy Improvement (third enemy)
features.description: Choose a third favored enemy and language.

features.name: Vanish
features.description: Hide as a bonus action, and you cannot be tracked by nonmagical means.

features.name: Shadowy Dodge
features.description: Use your reaction to impose disadvantage on an attack against you.

features.name: Share Spells
features.description: Spells you cast on yourself can also affect your nearby companion.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
features.description: Choose Evasion, Stand Against the Tide or Uncanny Dodge.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Feral Senses
features.description: Sense nearby invisible creatures and suffer no disadvantage attacking unseen foes.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Foe Slayer
features.description: Once per turn, add your Wisdom modifier to an attack or damage roll against a favored enemy.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: A precise, opportunistic striker who lives by stealth, skill, and knowing exactly where to put the knife.

subclassDescriptions.Arcane Trickster: A rogue who learns illusion and enchantment spells, with an invisible Mage Hand that can steal and pick locks from a distance. Later you can confuse enemies with your magic. Great for a clever, magical thief.
subclassDescriptions.Assassin: Masters of the first strike. You have advantage against creatures that haven't acted yet, and any hit on a surprised creature is a critical. You can also build perfect false identities. The best ambusher.
subclassDescriptions.Thief: The burglar. You use objects, pick locks and steal as a bonus action, climb faster and jump further, and at high level you take two turns in the first round. Ideal for heists and using magic items.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Double your proficiency bonus for two chosen skills or thieves' tools.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Once per turn, deal extra damage when you have advantage or an ally is next to your target.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.description: You know the secret slang and signs used by thieves to pass hidden messages.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: Dash, Disengage or Hide as a bonus action.

features.name: Assassinate
features.description: Gain advantage against creatures that have not acted yet, and hits against surprised foes are critical.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency with the disguise kit and poisoner's kit.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.description: Use Cunning Action to make Sleight of Hand checks, use thieves' tools or use an object.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.description: Your invisible mage hand can pick pockets, plant items and open locks.

features.name: Roguish Archetype
features.description: Choose the archetype that defines your roguish expertise.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.description: Climb at full speed and jump farther running.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Learn a small set of wizard spells, mostly enchantment and illusion, cast with Intelligence.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.description: Use your reaction to halve the damage of an attack from an attacker you can see.

features.name: Expertise (additional)
features.description: Choose two more proficiencies to gain double proficiency.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: Take no damage on a successful Dexterity save for half damage, and only half on a failure.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
features.description: Spend time and money to build a convincing false identity.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.description: Creatures have disadvantage on saves against your spells if you are hidden when you cast them.

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.description: Gain advantage on Stealth checks if you move no more than half your speed.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Reliable Talent
features.description: Treat any d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10 on ability checks with proficient skills.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Impostor
features.description: Flawlessly mimic another person's speech, writing and behavior after studying them.

features.name: Use Magic Device
features.description: Ignore class, race and level requirements when using magic items.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.description: Use your mage hand to distract a creature and gain advantage against it.

features.name: Blindsense
features.description: You know the location of hidden or invisible creatures within 10 feet if you can hear.

features.name: Slippery Mind
features.description: Gain proficiency in Wisdom saving throws.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Death Strike
features.description: A surprised creature you hit must pass a Constitution save or take double damage.

features.name: Spell Thief
features.description: Use your reaction to negate a spell aimed at you and steal knowledge of it for a time.

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.description: Take two turns in the first round of combat.

features.name: Elusive
features.description: No attack roll has advantage against you while you are not incapacitated.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Stroke of Luck
features.description: Turn a miss into a hit or a failed check into a 20 once per short rest.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.description: A caster whose magic is innate rather than learned, bending spells into new shapes on instinct.

subclassDescriptions.Draconic Bloodline: Your magic comes from a dragon ancestor. You gain extra hit points, natural armour, bonus damage with one element, and later dragon wings and a frightening presence. A tougher sorcerer and great elemental blaster.
subclassDescriptions.Shadow Magic: Your power comes from the Shadowfell. You see in magical darkness, can summon a shadow hound to hunt a target, teleport between shadows and refuse to die once per rest. A dark, mysterious caster.
subclassDescriptions.Wild Magic: Your magic is chaotic. Casting spells can trigger random surges (fireballs, turning blue, teleporting...), and you can control luck with Tides of Chaos. Fun and unpredictable; best for players who enjoy surprises.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.description: Gain an extra hit point per sorcerer level and natural armor of 13 plus Dexterity.

features.name: Dragon Ancestor
features.description: Choose a dragon type, learn Draconic and gain bonuses when dealing with dragons.

features.name: Eyes of the Dark
features.description: Gain darkvision and later see through your own darkness spells.

features.name: Sorcerous Origin
features.description: Your innate magic comes from a specific origin that grants features as you level.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Cast sorcerer spells using Charisma, powered by magic in your blood.

features.name: Strength of the Grave
features.description: When reduced to 0 hit points, you may make a Charisma save to drop to 1 instead.

features.name: Tides of Chaos
features.description: Gain advantage on one roll, with a chance to trigger a surge later.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge
features.description: Casting spells may unleash a random magical effect.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.description: Gain sorcery points that can be converted to and from spell slots.

features.name: Metamagic
features.description: Learn two ways to bend your spells, such as twinning, quickening or extending them.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Bend Luck
features.description: Spend sorcery points to add or subtract 1d4 from another creature's roll.

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.description: Add Charisma to damage of spells matching your ancestry and spend a point to resist that element.

features.name: Hound of Ill Omen
features.description: Spend sorcery points to summon a shadowy hound that hunts a target and weakens its saves.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Metamagic (additional option)
features.description: Learn one more Metamagic option.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Controlled Chaos
features.description: Roll twice on the surge table and choose the result.

features.name: Dragon Wings
features.description: Sprout dragon wings as a bonus action to gain a flying speed.

features.name: Shadow Walk
features.description: Teleport between shadows as a bonus action while in dim light or darkness.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Metamagic (final option)
features.description: Learn another Metamagic option.

features.name: Draconic Presence
features.description: Spend sorcery points to project an aura of awe or fear around you.

features.name: Spell Bombardment
features.description: When you roll maximum on a damage die, roll it again and add the result.

features.name: Umbral Form
features.description: Become a shadowy form that moves through objects and resists most damage.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Sorcerous Restoration
features.description: Regain 4 sorcery points whenever you finish a short rest.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.description: A caster who traded with something powerful and strange, and pays for the privilege in ways best not discussed.

subclassDescriptions.The Archfey: Your patron is a fey lord or lady. You can charm or frighten creatures around you, vanish when hurt, and later trap enemies in illusions. Great for a tricky, enchanting warlock.
subclassDescriptions.The Fiend: Your patron is a devil or demon. You gain temporary hit points whenever you kill an enemy, add fire spells like Fireball to your list, and later hurl foes through the lower planes. The sturdiest damage-dealing warlock.
subclassDescriptions.The Great Old One: Your patron is an alien, unknowable entity. You speak telepathically to any creature, can turn an enemy's attack against itself, and later charm minds with a touch. Ideal for a creepy psychic character.

features.name: Awakened Mind
features.description: Speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 30 feet.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.description: Gain temporary hit points whenever you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points.

features.name: Fey Presence
features.description: Charm or frighten creatures in a small cube around you once per short rest.

features.name: Otherworldly Patron
features.description: Strike a bargain with an otherworldly being that grants features and expanded spells.

features.name: Pact Magic
features.description: Cast warlock spells using Charisma with a few slots that are always cast at their highest level and refresh on a short rest.

features.name: Eldritch Invocations
features.description: Learn fragments of forbidden lore that grant lasting magical abilities.

features.name: Pact Boon
features.description: Your patron grants a gift: Pact of the Blade, the Chain or the Tome.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.description: Add a d10 to an ability check or saving throw once per short rest.

features.name: Entropic Ward
features.description: Impose disadvantage on an attack against you and gain advantage on your next attack if it misses.

features.name: Misty Escape
features.description: When damaged, use your reaction to turn invisible and teleport a short distance.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Beguiling Defenses
features.description: You are immune to being charmed and can turn charm attempts back on the caster.

features.name: Fiendish Resilience
features.description: Choose a damage type after each rest to gain resistance to it.

features.name: Thought Shield
features.description: Your thoughts cannot be read, you resist psychic damage and you reflect it back at attackers.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (6th level)
features.description: Choose one 6th-level spell you can cast once per long rest without a slot.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (7th level)
features.description: Choose one 7th-level spell you can cast once per long rest without a slot.

features.name: Create Thrall
features.description: Touch an incapacitated humanoid to charm it indefinitely and link with it telepathically.

features.name: Dark Delirium
features.description: Plunge a creature into an illusory realm where it is charmed or frightened for a minute.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.description: Send a creature you hit on a brief trip through the lower planes, dealing heavy psychic damage.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (8th level)
features.description: Choose one 8th-level spell you can cast once per long rest without a slot.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum (9th level)
features.description: Choose one 9th-level spell you can cast once per long rest without a slot.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Eldritch Master
features.description: Spend a minute pleading with your patron to regain all Pact Magic slots once per long rest.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: A scholar of magic whose power comes from study, preparation, and a very carefully guarded spellbook.

subclassDescriptions.School of Abjuration: Protective magic. When you cast abjuration spells (Shield, Counterspell, Dispel Magic...) you build a magical ward that absorbs damage, and later you can shield allies and resist spells. The toughest, most defensive wizard.
subclassDescriptions.School of Divination: Seers of the future. Twice per long rest you roll two d20s and can later replace any roll you see (yours, an ally's or an enemy's) with one of them (Portent). Divination spells refund themselves. Excellent for controlling luck and gathering information.
subclassDescriptions.School of Evocation: Battle mages who throw fire, lightning and force. You can shape your area spells so allies are untouched (Sculpt Spells), cantrips still hurt on a save, and you add Intelligence to spell damage. The best wizard for raw damage.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: Once per day during a short rest, recover expended spell slots up to half your wizard level.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Prepare spells from your spellbook and cast them using Intelligence.

features.name: Abjuration Savant
features.description: Copying abjuration spells into your spellbook costs half the gold and time.

features.name: Arcane Tradition
features.description: Choose a school of magic to specialize in.

features.name: Arcane Ward
features.description: Casting abjuration spells creates and recharges a magical ward that absorbs damage for you.

features.name: Divination Savant
features.description: Copying divination spells into your spellbook costs half the gold and time.

features.name: Evocation Savant
features.description: Copying evocation spells into your spellbook costs half the gold and time.

features.name: Portent
features.description: After a long rest, roll two d20s and use them to replace attack rolls, checks or saves.

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.description: Protect chosen allies from your evocation spells' area so they take no damage.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Expert Divination
features.description: Casting a divination spell of 2nd level or higher restores a lower-level spell slot.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.description: Creatures that succeed on saves against your cantrips still take half damage.

features.name: Projected Ward
features.description: Use your reaction to have your Arcane Ward absorb damage dealt to a nearby creature.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Empowered Evocation
features.description: Add your Intelligence modifier to the damage of your wizard evocation spells.

features.name: Improved Abjuration
features.description: Add your proficiency bonus to checks made with abjuration spells like counterspell.

features.name: The Third Eye
features.description: Gain darkvision, ethereal sight, the ability to read any language or see invisibility until your next rest.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Greater Portent
features.description: Roll three d20s for Portent instead of two.

features.name: Overchannel
features.description: Deal maximum damage with a lower-level spell, at the risk of necrotic damage to yourself on repeat use.

features.name: Spell Resistance
features.description: Gain advantage on saves against spells and resistance to spell damage.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Spell Mastery
features.description: Cast one chosen 1st-level and one 2nd-level spell at their lowest level without spending slots.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Signature Spells
features.description: Two chosen 3rd-level spells are always prepared and can each be cast once per rest without a slot.

classes.name: Artificer
classes.description: An inventor who explains 'magic' as engineering. Instead of spell slots the artificer spends energy charges (Steam-pressure, Thermal, Shock...) made at a fuel-burning workshop furnace (rests run the furnace on carried fuel) and builds devices from a growing blueprint book.

subclassDescriptions.Artillerist: Explosives and magical cannons. You deploy a turret (the Bolt Repeater, an Eldritch Cannon) that fires force bolts as a bonus action, patch allies or throw up cover with Combat Fabrication, and later add damage to your spells through an arcane firearm. A ranged damage dealer and battlefield gunner.
subclassDescriptions.Alchemist: Potions and elixirs. After each rest you brew experimental elixirs (healing, flight, resilience...), add Intelligence to healing and acid/fire/poison spells, and later restore conditions. A supportive healer-inventor.
subclassDescriptions.Armorer: You turn your armour into a power suit. Choose Guardian (thunder gauntlets that pull enemies' attention) or Infiltrator (lightning launcher, stealth and speed). You count as having heavy armour without Strength penalties. A front-line tank or striker.

features.name: Magical Tinkering
features.description: Give a tiny object a light, a recorded message, a smell or a moving picture.

features.name: Energy Charges
features.description: Your spells and devices run on energy charges instead of spell slots. Level 1 = Steam-pressure, 2 = Thermal, 3 = Shock, 4 = Force, 5 = Arcane Resonance. Charges are made at a workshop furnace from fuel: a long rest refills them all and a short rest up to half, if fuel is carried. Capsule blueprints can also refill one charge from parts. Mechanical devices take a stronger charge; tuned devices need their exact type.

features.name: Blueprint Book
features.description: Copy blueprints you find or buy into your book. A known blueprint can be built at any time from its materials, tools and (sometimes) charges.

features.name: Workshop Furnace
features.description: A carried furnace (tool with a furnace tier) burns fuel - wood 2, charcoal 3, coal 4, oil 5 units - and turns it into charges: 2 / 4 / 7 / 10 / 14 units per charge level. Upgraded furnaces unlock stronger charges.

features.name: Infuse Item
features.description: Infuse mundane gear with a lasting enhancement (e.g. +1 weapon, enhanced defense) for a long time.

features.name: Artificer Specialist
features.description: Choose Artillerist, Alchemist or Armorer.

features.name: The Right Tool for the Job
features.description: With tinker's tools, spend an hour to make any set of artisan's tools.

features.name: Bolt Repeater
features.description: Artillerist turret (Eldritch Cannon - Force Ballista): deploy with an action, fire with a bonus action, 2d6 force and a 5 ft push.

features.name: Combat Fabrication
features.description: 3 per long rest, bonus action: Emergency Patch, Quick Cover or Special Charge from prepared parts.

features.name: Experimental Elixir
features.description: After a long rest, brew a random elixir (healing, swiftness, resilience, boldness, flight, transformation).

features.name: Arcane Armor
features.description: Turn a suit of armor into a powered suit; choose the Guardian or Infiltrator model.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Arcane Firearm
features.description: Spells channelled through your Bolt Repeater or a carved firearm add 1d8 to one damage roll.

features.name: Alchemical Savant
features.description: Add your INT modifier to healing, acid, fire, necrotic or poison spells cast with alchemist's supplies.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Tool Expertise
features.description: Double proficiency bonus with any tool you are proficient with.

features.name: Flash of Genius
features.description: Reaction: add your INT modifier to an ally's ability check or saving throw.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Furnace Upgrade: Shock Coils
features.description: With an upgraded workshop (furnace tier 3) you can make Shock charges.

features.name: Magic Item Adept
features.description: Attune to 4 items and craft common/uncommon items in a quarter of the time.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Spell-Storing Item
features.description: Store a level 1 or 2 spell in an item; anyone can trigger it INT-mod x2 times.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Magic Item Master
features.description: Attune to up to 6 items.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Raise one ability score by 2 or two scores by 1 (to a maximum of 20), or take a feat instead.

features.name: Soul of Artifice
features.description: +1 to all saves per attuned item; once, drop to 1 HP instead of 0 by ending an infusion.
